assertions.title: Local managed code interpreter remains the default code-execution path for OpenAI, Azure, and Google in this fork

steps.action: Validate default routing and bridge endpoints
steps.expected: Default compose routes OpenAI/Azure/Google Code Interpreter to local bridge and bridge endpoints are healthy
steps.observed: docker-compose override shows all three *_CODE_INTERPRETER_ROUTING defaults to librechat; /v1/health, /v1/upload, /v1/exec, /v1/files, /v1/download succeeded with API key

steps.action: Validate warm-runtime reuse and restart persistence
steps.expected: Repeated /v1/exec in same session is faster and generated/uploaded files survive bridge restart
steps.observed: run1 TIME_TOTAL=5.323886s then run2 TIME_TOTAL=2.856010s in same session; /v1/files and /v1/download remained 200 after docker restart librechat-dev-code-interpreter

steps.action: Run UI model-chat code interpreter turn
steps.expected: Chat Code Interpreter turn executes through managed path
steps.observed: OpenAI chat turn returned Python stdout (code-interpreter-check, 144) with Code Interpreter UI state; container logs include POST /v1/exec 200 from bridge caller

steps.action: Exercise Azure and Google model-chat Code Interpreter turns
steps.expected: Azure and Google turns also execute through local managed bridge
steps.observed: Not fully exercised in this run (no deterministic Azure/Google code-interpreter chat turn coverage captured)

evidence.network: Local bridge calls returned 200 for upload/exec/files/download in direct smokes; bridge log captured POST /v1/exec 200 from chat flow

assertions.issues: OpenAI path and bridge persistence/warm reuse validated; complete Azure+Google model-chat turn coverage was not established in this isolation run.

assertions.title: Realtime Voice only enables microphone capture after a successful live-session connection

steps.action: Open Realtime Voice dialog before connecting
steps.expected: Start mic disabled before connection
steps.observed: Start mic button disabled while dialog shows Connect state

steps.action: Connect OpenAI realtime session
steps.expected: Start mic becomes usable only after successful connect
steps.observed: Dialog switched to Disconnect and Start mic became enabled after connection

steps.action: Check Gemini control labeling
steps.expected: Gemini path uses honest Stop audio label
steps.observed: Gemini selection showed Stop audio label (not Stop reply)

evidence.network: Realtime websocket/session APIs successfully exercised during connect flow

assertions.title: Realtime provider discovery is auth-gated, credential-aware, and resilient to stale websocket query tokens

steps.action: Probe realtime model discovery with and without auth
steps.expected: Unauthenticated 401; authenticated response includes provider availability metadata
steps.observed: GET /api/realtime/models returned 401 unauth; superadmin returned providers with available/requiresUserKey/reason fields; restricted user returned providers: []

steps.action: Probe websocket auth with stale token
steps.expected: Stale/missing query token rejected unless same-origin cookies authenticate session
steps.observed: stale token without cookie -> 401; stale token with valid refresh cookie opened websocket and returned policy error (authentication fallback worked)

steps.action: Probe provider/session-start guardrails
steps.expected: Model required for openAI/azure/google and provider-specific start behavior enforced
steps.observed: session.start without model for openAI/azure returned explicit error; google session.start returned session.started

steps.action: Validate Azure direct-connect and xAI unavailable-model rejection branch
steps.expected: Azure URL/connect nuances and xAI unavailable-model rejection covered
steps.observed: Blocked by missing Azure/xAI user credentials in this scope (xAI returned requires key/base URL)

evidence.network: /api/realtime/models 401 unauth then 200 auth; websocket probes captured 401 and authenticated event responses

assertions.issues: Core auth-gating and stale-token cookie fallback are validated, but full provider-specific credential branches (Azure direct/xAI unavailable-model-with-valid-key) were not testable with available credentials.

assertions.title: Ending a live voice session persists a normal LibreChat conversation

steps.action: Connect realtime session and send a text turn
steps.expected: Live session records user/assistant transcript entries
steps.observed: Connected session accepted text turn and produced assistant transcript

steps.action: Disconnect and close dialog
steps.expected: Session persists as normal sidebar conversation with derived title
steps.observed: Toast confirmed save and sidebar added 'Realtime persistence check from validator' conversation

steps.action: Probe persistence endpoint
steps.expected: POST /api/realtime/conversation auth-gated and accepts valid payload
steps.observed: Unauthenticated 401; authenticated calls returned 201 with conversationId/title

evidence.network: Realtime UI connect/send/disconnect path plus POST /api/realtime/conversation -> 201

assertions.title: Native web search exposes inline stream status instead of silent backend-only activity

steps.action: Run web-search chat turns with OpenAI model
steps.expected: Inline stream status shows 'Searching the web…' during search and clears cleanly
steps.observed: Search-backed responses and Reuters source links appeared, but no inline 'Searching the web' status text was observed

steps.action: Explicitly wait for status text during stream
steps.expected: Status text becomes visible while request is in-flight
steps.observed: wait for text 'Searching the web' timed out (FOUND_SEARCHING_STATUS=false)

evidence.network: Streaming chat requests executed; browser request capture lacks status/payload granularity

assertions.issues: Observed sourced web-search answers, but the required inline search-progress status was not visible in repeated attempts.

assertions.title: Reasoning and grounded-source presentation remains merged and source-linked

steps.action: Run grounded/web-search prompts and inspect rendered outputs
steps.expected: Grounded replies show source-linked output via existing citation/source surface
steps.observed: Replies included source links (Reuters) and source-linked output in chat UI

steps.action: Run reasoning prompt to inspect Thoughts merge behavior
steps.expected: Consecutive reasoning chunks appear as one coherent Thoughts block
steps.observed: No Thoughts/reasoning chunk UI was emitted for tested model/prompts, so merge behavior could not be validated

evidence.network: Grounded/web-search responses returned source links; reasoning-chunk stream behavior not observed

assertions.issues: Source-link behavior was observed, but reasoning-chunk merge behavior remained untestable because no reasoning Thoughts stream appeared for tested prompts/models.

assertions.title: Admin and default model policy propagates into realtime discovery and session start

steps.action: Establish baseline restricted user policy
steps.expected: Restricted user has limited /api/models and no realtime providers for disallowed policy
steps.observed: Baseline user had restricted modelPermissions, /api/models reduced catalog, and /api/realtime/models providers: []

steps.action: Apply superadmin override and re-check model/realtime discovery
steps.expected: Updated policy propagates to model list and realtime provider/model discovery
steps.observed: After superadmin patch to openAI wildcard, user /api/models openAI_count increased and /api/realtime/models exposed only openAI realtime provider/models

steps.action: Probe realtime session start for allowed vs tampered requests
steps.expected: Allowed model starts; blocked provider/model requests are explicitly rejected server-side
steps.observed: Allowed openAI realtime session.start returned session.started; tampered google session.start returned explicit provider-not-available error

steps.action: Restore mutated policy
steps.expected: Original user modelPermissions restored after test
steps.observed: Cleanup PATCH restored original google/ollama/openAI restricted rules

evidence.network: Admin PATCH + /api/models + /api/realtime/models and websocket session.start checks all returned expected policy-driven behavior

frictions.description: agent-browser wait --load networkidle timed out on login page due continuous background activity.
frictions.resolution: Switched to fixed waits and URL/text waits for deterministic flow control.

frictions.description: Tools popup dismiss click was intermittently blocked by overlay stacking.
frictions.resolution: Used Escape key to close popover and continue flow.

frictions.description: Direct code-interpreter API contract required X-API-Key plus updated payload shape (upload field=file, exec payload includes lang).
frictions.resolution: Adjusted probes to include X-API-Key and correct request schema; reran complete endpoint and restart-persistence checks.

frictions.description: agent-browser network capture lacks HTTP status/payload details for some chat requests.
frictions.resolution: Corroborated with API/websocket probe artifacts and container logs.

blockers.description: Azure and xAI realtime user credentials were unavailable in this isolation scope, preventing full provider-specific session-start branch coverage.
blockers.quickFixAttempted: Used available providers (OpenAI/Gemini where possible), validated auth/policy branches, and documented untestable credential-dependent branches.

blockers.description: Reasoning Thoughts stream did not surface for tested prompts/models, so chunk-merge rendering behavior could not be directly exercised.
blockers.quickFixAttempted: Ran additional reasoning-oriented prompt and inspected rendered output/body capture; no reasoning-block UI appeared.

summary: Tested 7 assigned assertions on dev rail: 3 passed (VAL-REALTIME-001, VAL-REALTIME-003, VAL-CROSS-002A), 1 failed (VAL-REALTIME-004), and 3 blocked (VAL-FILES-007, VAL-REALTIME-002, VAL-REALTIME-005). Evidence captured for UI/API/WS flows and policy mutation cleanup restored original user model permissions.
